info.name: Eka ABDM Connect
info.description:
Every ABDM Connect API and callback, in the order of the docs sidebar (145 requests).

1. Import the sandbox environment and fill in client_id and client_secret.
2. Run Authentication > Connect Login. It saves access_token for every other request.
3. Work through a milestone top to bottom. Each response's txn_id, request_id, order_id, provider_id and X-token (token) are saved for the steps after it.

Callback requests post the payload Eka sends to {{webhook_url}}, so you can test your own receiver.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/overview

Payer scheme type. Defaults to GOVT

request.description:
Lists payers from the NHCX participant registry. The participant_code is the payer_id used by every later call.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/search-payers

Finds a beneficiary's policies by mobile number, ABHA number or member ID. A mobile number can return several family members' policies. When nothing comes back, use Policy Discovery.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/search-policies

Asks the payer to find the policy for a member_id and payer_id when Search Policies returns nothing. Poll Policy Discovery Status for the result.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/discover-policy

query.description: member_id sent to Discover Policy
payer_id sent to Discover Policy

request.description:
Returns status pending until the payer answers, then found with the policy_id and product_id. Branch only on status.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/discovery-status

variable.description: policy_id from Search Policies or Policy Discovery Status

request.description:
Checks the policy is in force and returns the wallet balance, without creating a claim. cached true means the answer came from the last check; cached false with a request_id means a fresh check went to the payer, so call again shortly.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/check-eligibility

variable.description: policy_id from Search Policies or Policy Discovery Status

request.description:

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/refresh-plan

variable.description: policy_id from Search Policies or Policy Discovery Status

request.description:
Lists the procedures under one speciality of the policy's catalogue.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/list-procedures

variable.description: policy_id from Search Policies or Policy Discovery Status

request.description:
Full catalogue detail for a procedure: flags, costs, caps, mandatory documents and questionnaires. Check a feature's flag before reading its cap; payers publish non-zero caps on procedures where the feature is off.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/get-procedure

Creates the claim (the case every later call hangs off) and sends the auth-requirements check for the listed procedures. An open claim for the same policy and beneficiary is reused. The payer's per-procedure documents and questionnaires arrive on the coverage_eligibility request in Get Claim Requests.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/create-claim

query.description: facility (default) lists every claim of the calling facility
Lists one beneficiary's claims. Implies scope=beneficiary

request.description:
Lists claims with their beneficiary.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/list-claims

Claim summary: status, payer references, turn-around deadlines, review path, co-payment and the stages with a saved draft.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/get-claim

Saves a partly filled pre-auth or claim form without submitting it. The body is the same one the stage's submit takes, stored as sent. Read it back with Get Claim Request using correlation id draft:Preauth or draft:Claim.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/save-draft

Sets a claim aside so it is not reused. It stays readable. Refused with 400 while a pre-auth is live; cancel it first.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/archive-claim

Submits a pre-auth for the claim. request_type picks the workflow: InitialRequest, QueryResponse to answer a payer query, FollowUp to resubmit a rejected pre-auth, Enhancement to raise the approved scope. Everything the claim already knows (payer, policy, facility, patient) is filled in for you. The payer answers asynchronously: a 2xx means the request was sent, not approved. Track it with the returned request_id on Get Claim Request.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/submit-preauth

Cancels the claim's active pre-auth. The claim stays open and reusable. The body is optional; without a reason the default is used. The payer answers asynchronously: a 2xx means the request was sent, not approved. Track it with the returned request_id on Get Claim Request.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/cancel-preauth

Builds the pre-auth FHIR bundle from a full request without sending it.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/preview-preauth

Submits the final claim after discharge. request_type is empty for the first submit, QueryResponse to answer a payer query, FollowUp to resubmit a rejected claim. The claimed amount is the sum of itemized_billing. The payer answers asynchronously: a 2xx means the request was sent, not approved. Track it with the returned request_id on Get Claim Request.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/submit-claim

Takes the same body as Submit Claim and returns the exact FHIR bundle it would send. Nothing is sent or stored.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/preview-claim

query.description: Optional. Applies the claim's catalogue to the items

request.description:
Builds a claim FHIR bundle from a full claim request without sending it. Prefer Preview Claim Bundle once the claim exists.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/preview-claim-full

One-shot appeal of a rejected claim, or dispute of a claim settled with more than 20% deducted. A dispute needs a document; amount defaults to and cannot exceed the deduction. Get Claim's review_path says when this is allowed. The payer answers asynchronously: a 2xx means the request was sent, not approved. Track it with the returned request_id on Get Claim Request.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/reprocess-claim

Starts a biometric authentication of the claim's beneficiary for the pre-auth or claim stage. auth_mode is FINGERPRINT or IRIS. Discharge is accepted for Claim.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/biometric-init

Completes the authentication with the PID block from the RD-service scanner. Send the user_token with auth_type biometric on Submit Pre-auth or Submit Claim. For cyclic procedures send purpose cycle and procedure_code on every treatment visit.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/biometric-verify

Says whether a captured biometric consent for the stage is still valid, so you can reuse its user_token instead of capturing again.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/biometric-consent

Every biometric verify recorded on the claim. Cyclic claims take their cycle_dates from the cycle rows; next_capture_allowed_at is set while the 24 hour gap runs.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/biometric-sessions

Every exchange with the payer on this claim, oldest first: eligibility, pre-auth, claim, communication and more, each with its status and outcome.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/claim-requests

variable.description: request_id from a submit, or correlation_id from Get Claim Requests

request.description:
One exchange in full: what was sent (request_meta, documents), the parsed payer answer (response_meta, empty while pending) and the per-item verdicts (items).

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/claim-request

Streams a submitted document's bytes with its own content type.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/claim-request-document

Every payment notice the payer sent for the claim. Group rows by transaction_ref; a transaction's amount is its latest row's amount, not the sum.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/claim-payments

Registers where your HIS records API lives and how to call it, for the HIP in X-Hip-Id. Each capability is one templated HTTP call with an extract map; flows chain them. The records APIs read visit_ids and fhir from the finished flow.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/register-adapter

Returns the adapter registered for the HIP in X-Hip-Id. Auth headers are never returned.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/get-adapter

Lists an admission's visit ids through the HIP's registered adapter.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/admission-visits

Returns a visit's FHIR bundle through the HIP's registered adapter.

Docs: https://developer.eka.care/api-reference/user-app/abdm-connect/nhcx/visit-fhir
